response.sql: WITH q AS (SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM qualifying GROUP BY driverId), avg_q AS (SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drivers) AS avg_cnt) SELECT q.driverId AS driverId, q.cnt AS qualifying_count, q.cnt / avg_q.avg_cnt AS ratio_to_average FROM q CROSS JOIN avg_q ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10;
